doc: Per-model facts of mono_layer monokernels (NOT part of the family schema). The UT request author (references/request-authoring.md, references/mono-layer-ut.md 'Requesting a mono_layer task') makes the profiled kernels matching a model's `kernel` pattern one mono_layer task per model and copies that model's entry, bind, attrs and const axes into the task's `scaffold`. `case_axes` expressions may use shape / context and {serving-arg} placeholders filled from the serving launch args (e.g. --speculative-num-draft-tokens). `world` is the deployment's tp. Values come from the model's config and the serving launch: check them. `oracles_ready` lists the contract oracle legs this model's worked example implements and a GPU run verified; any other family oracle is dropped from the task's contract with a `scaffold.contract_overrides` entry and its why (the FILL agent is never left to write an oracle no example covers).
